snippet.title: Cronos: The New Dawn Deep Dive - Future Games Show gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Our second Ones to Watch Deep Dive focused on Cronos: The New Dawn, Bloober Team's time-travelling survival horror adventure. Mark your calendars, as it's coming to PC and consoles on September 5.
